integrity: Analytical derivation uses exact sampling and a logarithmic two-gap kernel. Standalone numerical and exact-polynomial checks supplement the proof; no independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to four independent area-uniform samples in homothetic planar shells about a fixed interior origin, with C3 positively curved boundaries. Exact leading asymptotic only; no uniform error estimate or higher-dimensional claim. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Logarithmic Sylvester defect for thin homothetic shells of smooth convex bodies
